backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, Nakshatra CRUD operations with admin-only write access, image storage, and access control using MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that usePasscodeAuth hook properly authorizes backend write operations for Nakshatra data updates and image replacements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including components, hooks, pages, and utilities for the Nakshatra application with admin authentication and image upload functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a cosmic aesthetic with purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Star Field Explorer application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, Nakshatra details, and admin pages (wrapped in AdminGuard), plus ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that renders PasscodeEntry if not authenticated via usePasscodeAuth, otherwise renders children.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogoutButto: Logout button component that clears passcode auth, Internet Identity, and React Query cache, then shows success toast.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner displaying current Nakshatra with Moon position, pada number, and expandable section showing detailed pada information including navamsa sign and interpretive description.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link including UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with Star Field Explorer branding, Moon icon, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin sections.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent header, footer, and main content structure using React Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a grid of all 27 Nakshatras as clickable cards with images, highlighting the current Nakshatra where the Moon is positioned. Handles loading states for backend canister initialization and fetches Nakshatra images from the backend.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Provides an image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, and progress tracking. Converts uploaded files to Uint8Array for backend storage and allows image removal.
frontend/src/components/PasscodeEntry.ts: Renders a passcode entry form for admin access that validates a hardcoded passcode before initiating Internet Identity authentication. Shows loading states during authentication flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control with an admin token from URL parameters. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Provides the current Nakshatra based on Moon position, automatically refreshing every 5 minutes using the nakshatraEngine utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider with login/logout functionality, identity management, and configurable AuthClient options. Manages authentication state and exposes login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: Provides a mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data and optionally replacing images, with automatic query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasscodeAuth.ts: Manages admin authentication flow combining passcode validation with Internet Identity login, using sessionStorage for persistence and custom events for cross-component state synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching Nakshatra data from the backend actor, including getAllNakshatras, readNakshatra by name, and getImage by ID. Implements error transformation, initialization error detection, and exponential backoff retry logic for canister availability issues.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark-themed design system, defining colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, primary/secondary colors, borders, and chart colors using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing a single Nakshatra's details including description, deity, symbol, characteristics, four padas, and image upload. Handles form state, image uploads, and mutation submission with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying a grid of all Nakshatras with thumbnails and edit buttons. Shows loading states during canister initialization, error alerts for failures, and includes admin logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page explaining Nakshatras with introductory text, displaying the current Nakshatra banner, and rendering a grid of all Nakshatras. Handles initialization and error states with appropriate UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for a single Nakshatra showing its image, description, characteristics, and four padas in tabs. Merges backend data with fallback pada data, displays current Nakshatra badge, and handles loading/error states.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Defines Nakshatra data structures and implements astronomical calculations for determining Moon's position in Nakshatras, including Julian Day conversion and ecliptic longitude computation using simplified Jean Meeus algorithms.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Contains detailed descriptive content for each Nakshatra pada (quarter), including degree ranges, Navamsa signs, titles, and extensive interpretive descriptions for astrological reference.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, with support for both standard query strings and hash-based routing, including parameter persistence and cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugin integrations for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking a known issue where admin dashboard shows permission errors when saving Nakshatra edits and images, with pending feature requests to fix backend authorization logic.
